a: Latency is time per request; throughput is requests per second.
High percentiles show tail latency users actually feel.
When utilization is high, wait time explodes — keep spare capacity.
Calling many services in series adds latency; parallelize when safe.
Chatty per-item API calls kill mobile performance; batch instead.
Large JSON payloads cost bandwidth and parse time — trim fields.
HTTP keep-alive / connection pools avoid handshake tax.
First request after idle pays startup cost (Render free tier, Lambdas).
Keep hot data close to compute (memory, then region, then origin).
Profile before optimizing; guesses waste time.
